computed.right: auto (computed box right=238px at this viewport)
computed.background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0) — background painted by a separate layered element, not the flex root

backdrop.note: No dedicated full-viewport scrim — page dims/blurs only via panel's own backdrop-blur; hero content stays visible/blurred behind the small centred card.

computed.note: outer list wrapper is block (js-items-inner-container); each row is its own flex row (space-between) pairing the link with an optional decorative icon

secondary_blocks.summary: header bar with logo, 'YOU MADE IT' label, minimise/close control (not a menu link)
decorative spinner/asterisk icon glyph next to 2 of the 5 items (What we do, Careers)
2-up button row: 'SCHEDULE A CALL' (light) + 'START A PROJECT' (light) — opens a multi-step contact form flow inside the same panel shell

close.note: top-right control is a '—' minimise glyph inside the panel header row, not a separate fixed-position X

motion.panel_transition_or_animation: transition: all (panel animates position/opacity/blur as it expands from the collapsed toggle button into the full card)
motion.item_stagger: not cheaply observable via static computed-style read
